# 模块与制品

每次发布以 `me.ahoo.wow` 为 group 发布到 Maven Central 的每个制品，由构建（[`build.gradle.kts`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/blob/main/build.gradle.kts) 里的 `abiProjects` 与 `publishedLibraries`）与每个模块自己的 description 生成；说明取自源码，为英文。导入 BOM，其余制品不写版本：

`implementation(platform("me.ahoo.wow:wow-bom:<version>"))`，然后 `implementation("me.ahoo.wow:wow-spring-boot")` 等都不带版本。Gradle 插件 `me.ahoo.wow` 接好编译器（KSP）并汇总服务的 Manifest。

| 制品 | 目录 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-bom` | [`bom/bom`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/bom/bom) | BOM：下列每个制品的版本，构建以 platform 导入。 |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-dependencies` | [`bom/dependencies`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/bom/dependencies) | Wow 运行时放到应用类路径上的那些库的版本（Jackson、协程、kotlin-logging、SLF4J），从 `wow-spi` 起每个发布的 POM 都导入它；除此之外不管别的，依赖 Wow 的模块对 Wow 不用的库保留自己的版本。契约模块（`wow-annotations`、`wow-api`、`wow-query-api`、`wow-manifest`）不导入它：只依赖它们的领域模块对所有库都保留自己的版本。Spring Boot BOM 只随 `wow-spring-boot` 而来。 |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-annotations` | [`api/annotations`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/api/annotations) | The stability markers of Wow's API (InternalWowApi, ExperimentalWowApi, WowSpi), which every Wow module builds on; no dependencies |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-api` | [`api/api`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/api/api) | What domain code imports (the annotations, Decision, DecideScope, StateEvent, Scope), the value types of the wire contract (Command, CommandResult, WaitPlan) and the typed QueryApi |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-manifest` | [`api/manifest`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/api/manifest) | The contract every projection reads (REST, OpenAPI, clients, views, Skills); plain data |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-query-api` | [`api/query-api`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/api/query-api) | The query protocol (filters, sort, pagination, projection, aggregation) and the query field annotations, as plain data; nothing but the stability markers |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-spi` | [`core/spi`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/core/spi) | The ports a backend implements (log, snapshots, checkpoints, leases, failure ledger, reservations, sinks) |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-kernel` | [`core/kernel`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/core/kernel) | The aggregate model and the decide, evolve, append loop |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-runtime` | [`core/runtime`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/core/runtime) | Gateway, router, cluster channel, executor, subscriptions, waits and lifecycle |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-reactor` | [`core/reactor`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/core/reactor) | Reactor adapters for the user programming model |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-query` | [`query/query`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/query/query) | The query engine over the snapshot, event and dataset models, and its backend SPI |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-postgres` | [`backends/postgres`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/backends/postgres) | Log, snapshots, query, checkpoints, leases, failure ledger and reservations on PostgreSQL |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-mongo` | [`backends/mongo`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/backends/mongo) | Log, snapshots, query, checkpoints, leases, failure ledger and reservations on MongoDB |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-kafka` | [`backends/kafka`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/backends/kafka) | The Kafka transport, Kafka Sink and Kafka-sourced subscriptions |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-clickhouse` | [`backends/clickhouse`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/backends/clickhouse) | The ClickHouse Sink and the dataset query backend |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-elasticsearch` | [`backends/elasticsearch`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/backends/elasticsearch) | Snapshots, their queries and the event search Sink on Elasticsearch |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-openapi` | [`edge/openapi`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/edge/openapi) | The OpenAPI 3.1 document of a service's public routes, from its Manifest alone; plain data |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-http` | [`edge/http`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/edge/http) | Routes materialized from the Manifest, problem+json, SSE and the signal entry |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-client` | [`edge/client`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/edge/client) | The typed command and query clients of a peer's HTTP routes, on the JDK HttpClient |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-cosec` | [`edge/cosec`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/edge/cosec) | The caller from CoSec's security context, and command authorization |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-observability` | [`edge/observability`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/edge/observability) | Tracing and Micrometer metrics on the core's observation seams |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-spring-boot` | [`host/spring-boot`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/host/spring-boot) | Auto-configuration by classpath; wiring only |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-cosid` | [`extensions/cosid`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/extensions/cosid) | CosId's generators as a node's global and aggregate id generators |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-models` | [`extensions/models`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/extensions/models) | Shared capability interfaces, EnumText and the reusable Tree aggregate |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-test` | [`test/test-dsl`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/test/test-dsl) | The aggregate and processor specs that run a domain on the kernel |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-tck` | [`test/tck`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/test/tck) | The contract specs of the SPI ports that every backend runs |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-query-tck` | [`query/query-tck`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/query/query-tck) | The contract specs every query backend runs (snapshots, events, datasets) |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-tck-containers` | [`test/tck-containers`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/test/tck-containers) | The Testcontainers the backends' integration tests run the TCK specs against |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-ops-api` | [`platform/ops/ops-api`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/platform/ops/ops-api) | The commands, events and value types of the ops context |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-view-store-api` | [`platform/view-store/view-store-api`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/platform/view-store/view-store-api) | The commands, events and value types of the view store context |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-compiler` | [`compiler/compiler`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/compiler/compiler) | Aggregate models and Manifest fragments from the annotations |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-gradle-plugin` | [`compiler/gradle-plugin`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/compiler/gradle-plugin) | Applies KSP and wow-compiler, and assembles the Manifest with Jackson-introspected schemas |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-migrate-data` | [`migration/migrate-data`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/migration/migrate-data) | Imports 9.x event streams into the V10 log and verifies them |
| `me.ahoo.wow:wow-manifest-tools` | [`compiler/manifest-tools`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/tree/main/compiler/manifest-tools) | Completes Manifest fragments with Jackson-introspected schemas and merges them; run by wow-gradle-plugin in isolated workers, never at runtime |
